## Artwork Destroyed in the Los Angeles Wildfires (January 2025)

A trove of nearly 200 artworks by Hunter Biden was destroyed in the wildfires ravaging Los Angeles in January 2025, according to a source close to the Biden family.[n] The pieces had been in storage near the Pacific Palisades home of his Hollywood attorney Kevin Morris and were valued at "millions of dollars."[n] Morris — who had loaned the first son nearly $5 million to help pay a tax bill and was financing a documentary about him — lived in a five-bedroom, six-bathroom home reported to be among the few still intact in the neighborhood.[n] Badlands commentary treated the loss as emblematic, writing that "the four years of utter fakery are simply unwinding themselves before our eyes."[n]

## Cost and Casualties

Early estimates indicated the wildfires that erupted across Los Angeles County in January 2025 were on track to be among the costliest natural disasters in United States history.[n] As of mid-January the blazes had killed at least 11 people and incinerated more than 12,000 structures since Tuesday of that week, destroying entire neighborhoods that had been home to multimillion-dollar properties.[n] A preliminary AccuWeather assessment put damage and total economic losses at between $135 billion and $150 billion, a figure that would make the fires the costliest in US history.[n]
